nongovt_bars.formula: USSC FY 2018-method components 5 + 8 as a share of range-known cases
nongovt_bars.title: Below the range without a government motion, FY 2025, districts with 200 or more cases

band.label: Middle half of districts (25th to 75th percentile)

ribbon.formula: percentiles of the 94 published district shares each year (linear interpolation)
ribbon.title: Within-range share across the 94 districts

split_stack.formula: FY 2018 on: above = USSC SENTRNGE groups 1 + 6; government sponsored = 2 + 3 + 4 + 7; not government sponsored = 5 + 8 (each as a share of range-known cases)
split_stack.how: USSC four-way grouping as printed for FY 2006 to 2017, then rebuilt from the FY 2018 method's components. The two agree exactly in FY 2014 to 2017.
split_stack.title: How federal sentences compare with the guideline range, all districts

within_line.formula: FY 2004 and FY 2005 pool the USSC's two half-year tables: (cases in both halves within range) / (range-known cases in both halves) x 100
within_line.how: USSC packets (FY 1995 to 2001, national column) and datafiles (FY 2002 on).
within_line.title: Share of federal sentences within the guideline range, all districts

nongovt.formula: USSC FY 2018-method components 5 + 8 as a share of range-known cases
nongovt.higher_means: more below-range sentences without a government motion
nongovt.how: Rebuilt from the USSC's FY 2018 method; identical to the printed grouping in FY 2014 to 2017.
nongovt.label: Below the range, not sponsored by the government

within.higher_means: more sentences within the guideline range
within.how: USSC packets (FY 1995 to 2001) and datafiles. FY 2004 and FY 2005 pool two half-year tables.
within.label: Sentenced within the guideline range

above_2025.formula: sum of the USSC's FY 2018-method components as a share of range-known cases

fy_first.how: First fiscal year in the USSC series.

govt_2025.formula: sum of the USSC's FY 2018-method components as a share of range-known cases

iqr_2004.formula: 75th percentile minus 25th percentile of the 94 district within-range shares, FY 2004 (linear interpolation)
iqr_2004.how: Spread of the middle half of districts.

iqr_2025.formula: 75th percentile minus 25th percentile of the 94 district within-range shares, FY 2025 (linear interpolation)
iqr_2025.how: Spread of the middle half of districts.

k1_1995.how: National share of sentences with a substantial-assistance (section 5K1.1) departure, FY 1995.

k1_2025.how: National share of sentences with a substantial-assistance (section 5K1.1) departure, FY 2025.

median_2004.formula: median of the 94 district within-range shares, FY 2004

median_2025.formula: median of the 94 district within-range shares, FY 2025

min_base.how: Threshold chosen for this comparison: districts with at least this many range-known cases.

n_80_2004.formula: count of districts with a within-range share of 80% or more in FY 2004

n_big.formula: count of districts with at least 200 range-known cases in FY 2025

n_districts.how: Districts with a published within-range share.

n_major_2004.formula: count of districts whose within-range share exceeds 50% in FY 2004

n_major_2023.formula: count of districts whose within-range share exceeds 50% in FY 2023

n_major_2025.formula: count of districts whose within-range share exceeds 50% in FY 2025

ng_hi.how: District at the high end, FY 2025, 200+ cases.

ng_hi_value.formula: sum of the USSC's FY 2018-method components 5 + 8 as a share of range-known cases
ng_hi_value.how: Share of the district's sentences below the range without a government motion.

ng_lo.how: District at the low end, FY 2025, 200+ cases.

ng_lo_value.formula: sum of the USSC's FY 2018-method components 5 + 8 as a share of range-known cases
ng_lo_value.how: Share of the district's sentences below the range without a government motion.

ng_median_big.formula: median across districts with 200+ range-known cases, FY 2025

nongovt_2025.formula: sum of the USSC's FY 2018-method components as a share of range-known cases

nongovt_peak.formula: sum of the USSC's FY 2018-method components
nongovt_peak.how: Highest national share of below-range sentences without a government motion.

post_first.how: First full fiscal year after Booker.

post_max.formula: highest national within-range share, FY 2006 to FY 2025
post_max.how: Maximum of the published national shares.

post_min.how: Lowest national within-range share since Booker.

pre_last.how: Last full fiscal year before Booker.

pre_max.formula: highest national within-range share, FY 1995 to FY 2004
pre_max.how: Maximum of the national shares (FY 2004 pools the USSC's two half-year tables, so it is derived).

pre_min.formula: lowest national within-range share, FY 1995 to FY 2004
pre_min.how: Minimum of the published national shares.

within_first.how: National within-range share, FY 1995, as published (E.D. Va. packet, national column).

within_latest.how: National share of sentences within the guideline range, FY 2025, as published.

zero80_since.how: Start of the run of years, through the latest, in which no district reached 80% within range.
